messages:
maya (PM): ok team — proposal: 'dynamic burst shaping' as a dedicated-capacity feature. goal: let customers get short, predictable bursts without overprovisioning reserved pools.
ross (Eng): short thread: what does shaping mean here? smoothing vs strict quota?
maya (PM): think smoothing + predictive headroom. when a tenant spikes, we allow short burst beyond reserved quota if predictions say capacity will free up within X mins. otherwise trim to baseline.
li (SRE): main concerns: correctness of prediction, risk of cascading preemptions, and observability. need fallbacks if prediction fails.
anu (Sales): customers asking for this — three enterprise pilots specifically requested: retail search, realtime summarization, and a fintech partner. they want clear SLAs during bursts.
julia (Solutions): can we expose two knobs: burst window (seconds) and max-burst-multiplier? that makes it easier for tenants to tune.
ross (Eng): agree. implementation sketch: predictor service that consumes recent queue depth + model variant latency. controller applies temporary soft-quota to pool -> routing layer honors soft-quota until expiry.
ross (Eng): quick pseudo-config example:
```
pool: default-reserved
burst: { window_s: 300, multiplier: 3, fallback: "throttle" }
```
li (SRE): need metrics: burst_accept_rate, burst_evict_rate, burst_latency_tail_p95/p99, predictive_accuracy. also tracing tags for when requests use burst capacity.
maya (PM): launch criteria proposal (need sign-off):
- two pilots completed for 6 weeks each with no severe customer-impacting preemptions (>=99.95% success of requests)
- p99 latency during burst <= 2x baseline p99 or absolute threshold (configurable)
- telemetry shows predictor precision >= 70% on held-out windows
- RBAC + UI for admins to set pool-level burst policy
li (SRE): add: observability alerts for sustained >15% burst usage for >30m (indicates misconfig or attack).
anu (Sales): commercial asks: how do we bill bursts? 1) keep billed as normal tokens and show burst delta in invoice, or 2) include burst credits in reserved contracts. customers prefer explicit credits.
maya (PM): decision: support both — show burst usage line item and allow customers to buy burst credits; default behavior is capped per contract. include trial credits for pilots.
julia (Solutions): rollout plan:
1) internal dogfood on low-risk pool (one week)
2) two enterprise pilots (staggered)
3) GA with credit billing and UI controls
ross (Eng): rough effort: predictor + controller (3w), routing + runtime quota hook (2w), UI + billing integration (2w), telemetry/alerts (1w). total ~8 weeks dev + 2 weeks testing/rollout.
maya (PM): dependencies: pricing/billing, console team for UI, infra for safe rollout flags, legal for contract language on bursts.
li (SRE): ops playbook for incidents:
- detection: alert for sustained high burst_evict_rate
- mitigation: scale up reserved pools, reduce default multiplier, enable strict preemption path
- communication: incident channel template and customer notify script
ross (Eng): one technical risk: KV-cache pressure with kvs reused by burst paths -> might increase mem footprint. will prototyping measure memory delta.
julia (Solutions): customer acceptance criteria for pilots:
- documented workload runbook,
- no dropped critical requests during pilot window,
- monthly invoice that clearly separates burst usage
anu (Sales): I'll line up the two pilot customers and confirm timelines. they want 6-week pilots starting early next quarter.
maya (PM): decision summary: greenlight MVP with conservative defaults (window_s=300, multiplier=2), billing show + optional credits, pilot cadence 6w x2. owners: ross (eng) predictor/controller, li (sre) telemetry & playbook, julia (solutions) pilot onboarding, anu (sales) customer contracts, maya (pm) overall.
ross (Eng): I'll open RFC and engineering tickets by EOD Monday.
deploy-bot: deploy-staging: new feature flag created: feature/dynamic-burst-shaping -> enabled: false
maya (PM): next actions: ross create RFC, li draft ops playbook, julia + anu prep pilot kickoff pack. sync Wed 11am PT. :thumbsup:
